title: High-Protein Cheeseburger Roll-Ups
summary: Lean minced beef cooked with onion and smoky spices, made creamy with stock, cream cheese, ketchup, mustard and pickles. It's rolled into tortillas with cheese and baked until golden. Makes 9 and freezes well.

steps.text: Spray a pan with cooking spray, add the 800 g lean beef and get a crispy sear before breaking it up.
Season with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp cayenne and 2 tsp salt, and mix well.
Add 200 ml beef stock, 120 g light cream cheese, 90 g ketchup, 10 g mustard and 120 g diced pickles. Mix until creamy and let it simmer.

ingredients.note: He suggests a low-carb wrap as an alternative
His own suggested tweak, to make it taste more like a cheeseburger

steps.text: Lay a tortilla flat and add one ninth of the beef mix and 20 g low-fat cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll it up tight. Repeat to make 9 rolls.
Lay the rolls on a lined tray, spray them with cooking spray and sprinkle with parsley.
Bake at 180 °C for 10–12 minutes, until golden.
To meal prep, wrap the rolls and freeze them; reheat when needed.

notes: A remake: the description credits the original recipe to @Panacea Palm. Louis rates it 8/10.
The video sears the beef first and then adds the onion. The written method cooks the onion first. Either works.
The oven setting (180 °C, 10–12 min) is shown on screen. The description says “toast or air fry until golden and crispy” instead.
gaps: How long to brown the beef and simmer the sauce isn't given.
How to reheat from frozen isn't given.
